# NPM Improved v1.7.10 — Go security rebuild

Security maintenance release based on the previously published v1.7.9 source. All existing v1.7.9 features, native host updater behavior, NPMX synchronization, reverse-proxy configuration, database content, and administrator UI are retained.

- Rebuild the privileged Go control-plane executable with Go 1.27.4 (November 10, 2026 security fixes) instead of 1.27.3.
- Update Go module metadata, the final-image Go-version assertion, and the incremental-runtime security assertions to the new compiler baseline.
- Preserve the existing hardened Node.js 24.22.1 and NGINX 1.31.8 runtime overlays.
- Apply established multi-arch image validation, public GitHub release assets, and signed/checksummed host-updater package contracts. No version reuse or image downgrades.

Use Settings → Update once the v1.7.10 GitHub release and its downloadable checksum-verified images are published. Production operators should not deploy an unqualified image.
